description: A Java class implementing a PredicateVisitor for evaluating whether 'Thing' objects match specific filter criteria, including comparison and pattern matching.

classes.name: ThingPredicatePredicateVisitor
classes.description: A singleton class implementing PredicateVisitor to generate predicates for matching 'Thing' objects based on various comparison operations.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the visitor.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Creates a predicate for a 'Thing' based on a Ditto query predicate and a field name.

methods.name: visitEq
methods.description: Creates a predicate to check if a field equals a given value.

methods.name: visitNe
methods.description: Creates a predicate to check if a field does not equal a given value.

methods.name: visitGe
methods.description: Creates a predicate to check if a field is greater than or equal to a value.

methods.name: visitGt
methods.description: Creates a predicate to check if a field is greater than a value.

methods.name: visitLe
methods.description: Creates a predicate to check if a field is less than or equal to a value.

methods.name: visitLt
methods.description: Creates a predicate to check if a field is less than a value.

methods.name: visitIn
methods.description: Creates a predicate to check if a field's value is within a list of values.

methods.name: visitLike
methods.description: Creates a predicate to check if a string field matches a regex pattern.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two Comparable objects, attempting numeric conversion for accurate comparison.

methods.name: asNumber
methods.description: Converts a Comparable to a BigDecimal if it is a Number, for comparison purposes.

methods.name: getThingField
methods.description: Retrieves a field value from a Thing as an Optional<JsonValue>.

methods.name: mapJsonValueToJava
methods.description: Maps a JsonValue to a corresponding Java object, supporting strings, booleans, numbers, and nulls.
